event_name: Date 24 July 2022 Time 17:12 2022 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 July 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged incident between cars 6 and 20 at T2.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that no driver was wholly or predominantly to blame for the collision. LAT overtook MAG on the inside of turn 1 and was slightly ahead of MAG at the apex of turn 2 on the outside. Contact occurred between MAG and LAT just after the apex of turn 2. Both cars sustained damage and retired from the race. The Stewards considered that both drivers contributed to the collision. LAT could have left more room for MAG on the inside of turn 2 but MAG must have known that LAT was on the outside and could have taken a tighter line through turn 2 or yielded to LAT.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 6 Alleged Incident With Car 20
